/**
 * Deterministic citation-resolution lint. Walks structured ID-bearing fields
 * in a stage's artifact and checks that every emitted `source_ref` and
 * `scenario_id` resolves to a row in its home upstream artifact.
 *
 * Slice 2B cutover (ticket C4, plan section 3.4): the `note_id` kind and its
 * validate-backed universe are gone with the note system. `source_ref`
 * replaces it: the universe is built from the run's trace store (every
 * `chunk_ref`/`article_ref` any traced Feed call this run made actually
 * returned, plus the seeded `window_articles` refs) — the grounding rule is
 * "a ref may be cited only if some traced Feed call in this run actually
 * returned it", not a note-store lookup. The caller (linting.ts) builds this
 * universe from `services.feedTraceRecorder` and injects it into `upstream`
 * under the `__feed_refs` key so this module stays pure (no I/O, no LLM,
 * microsecond runtime) — it only ever reads what its caller hands it.
 *
 * Strict-stage homing:
 *   - source_ref  → retrieve (the run's trace store + seeded window_articles)
 *   - scenario_id → analyze.scenarios[].scenario_id
 *
 * Free-text prose mentions are NOT linted — only structured fields are
 * load-bearing for downstream reasoning. See ADR-0015 and CONTEXT.md term
 * "Citation-resolution lint".
 *
 * The lint is pure and deterministic. No I/O, no LLM, microsecond runtime.
